page_title: BRE 3-1 LUT | Brentford v Luton 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Anthony Taylor is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Wow, what an escape. Yoane Wissa (Brentford) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
90+2' Substitution. Myles Peart-Harris (Brentford) has come on for Neal Maupay.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Tahith Chong (Luton) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
90' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Luton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
88' Tahith Chong (Luton) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
87' Luton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
87' The corner is swung in but Luton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Luton get a corner.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Luton comes to nothing.
81' 3 - 1 Goal! Shandon Baptiste (Brentford) fires the rebound into the top right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:1.

81' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Thomas Kaminski anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
81' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
78' That's the end of the game for Bryan Mbeumo, who is replaced by Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford).
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) for Saman Ghoddos.
76' 2 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Jacob Brown (Luton) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom left corner.
76' Rob Edwards is forced to make a change. Teden Mengi (Luton) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ryan Giles.
74' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) swings in a cross from the corner, but Thomas Kaminski reads it well and gathers the ball.
73' Looks like Teden Mengi (Luton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

72' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
70' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Shandon Baptiste (Brentford) replacing Yegor Yarmolyuk.
70' Gabriel Osho (Luton) makes a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Brentford.
69' Brentford quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
69' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The linesman makes the right call and Brentford will have a corner.
68' 18:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
65' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
64' Anthony Taylor couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Gabriel Osho (Luton) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Brentford, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
61' Substitution. Carlton Morris makes his way off the pitch and Elijah Adebayo (Luton) comes on as his replacement.
60' Rob Edwards decides to make a substitution. Chiedozie Ogbene will be replaced by Andros Townsend (Luton).
60' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jordan Clark (Luton).

60' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
60' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
59' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Brentford force a corner. They send men into the box.
56' 2 - 0 Ben Mee (Brentford) rises high to meet the corner from Bryan Mbeumo and plants a low header into the middle of the goal, leaving Thomas Kaminski beaten. The score is 2:0.
56' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
56' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brentford will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
55' Wasted opportunity. Frank Onyeka (Brentford) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.

53' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now.
50' Tahith Chong (Luton) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
49' 1 - 0 Goal! Neal Maupay (Brentford) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
49' A lofted pass picks out Ben Mee (Brentford) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender.
46' It will be a substitution. Jacob Brown (Luton) is ready to enter the pitch as Tom Lockyer walks off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Anthony Taylor has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Some patient build-up play from Brentford as they look to unlock the defence.
45' Brentford are seeing far more of the ball now.
43' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
43' Surely that's handball by one of the Luton players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
42' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but Thomas Kaminski comes off his line to gather the ball.
41' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
40' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
38' It's like he was asking for a caution. Thomas Kaminski (Luton) receives a yellow card.
38' Brentford work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

37' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. Brentford win a corner kick.
37' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
35' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
35' The possession of the ball – 74:26.
33' Issa Kabore (Luton) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
32' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
31' Amari'i Bell (Luton) commits a rough foul. Anthony Taylor stops the game and makes a call. A free kick to Brentford.

29' Fine play by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
28' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brentford.

27' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes out of play and Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
27' Brentford take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
26' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford). The linesman points to the corner flag, Brentford are going to take it.
24' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
21' Neal Maupay (Brentford) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Thomas Kaminski makes a comfortable save.
19' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
18' Ross Barkley (Luton) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
17' Issa Kabore (Luton) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. Luton will have a chance to score from a corner.
16' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Luton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
16' Ben Mee (Brentford) commits a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. Luton are awarded a free kick.
13' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford).
11' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Neal Maupay (Brentford) picks up a long through ball, but Thomas Kaminski deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
8' A cross into the box from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is cleared.
7' Brentford hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
3' Tom Lockyer (Luton) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Luton will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
